integrity: All mathematical claims concern the stated exact real-arithmetic model. Quadrature and Monte Carlo are supporting checks, not substitutes for the proof. Originality comparisons are non-exhaustive and independent validation has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: The theorem covers Gaussian sketches of rank-one PSD Hessians, independent deterministic scalar regularization, m>=2 and d>m; it does not cover the data-adaptive regularizer, general spectra or full optimization trajectories.
title: Finite-sample scalar-debiasing obstruction for rank-one Gaussian inverse-Hessian sketches
